text: Yes, that's me. Wondering how this happened?
Let's start from the morning. A new bike arrived in the colony.
New bike! Eighty thousand rupees. Not one rupee less!
My papa's bike! What does your papa have?
My papa has... a moustache!
My papa has a moustache too... plus a bike!
Moustache?! Now it's a matter of my honour!
By evening, my ride will rule this lane!
Did you hear? Ramesh is bringing a car, big as an aeroplane!
The ride arrived by evening... pushed, not driven.
She has arrived... my lioness.
Does it run, or does it need a push too?
It's vintage! Vintage means old, but priceless!
I fear nobody!
Hahaha! Scooty fifteen thousand, smoke is free!
Seth ji!
It's on, Papa!
What if evil eye strikes? Lemon-chilli is a must!
The whole colony will see! My son's ride!
Hair so perfect today... even the bike will blush.
Wear the helmet.
Helmet ruins my hair, Pooja! Never!
Enough! Now watch me.
I fear nobody... except lizards!
Lizard gone. Now your hair goes.
Papa, helmet's on backwards!
I know! It's for the one behind!
We're live! Papa's backwards helmet!
My hair... rest in peace.
Fasten the strap too.
Tomorrow.
No tension! I'll teach you today.
No clutch in a scooty, just rev!
Bhaiya, start it first!
Look! I'm flying!
Hero! Ten kilometres done!
Without moving!
Rev it! Go! Go!
Go how? It's going backwards!
Brake! Brake! Hand brake!
I'm fine. Scooty's fine too.
Evil eye! Didn't I tell you?
Sigh. Lemons can't brake, Nani.
Tinku! Learn yourself first!
No tension... her aim is always perfect.
I have an idea! We can ride better than Papa.
I'll sit behind... with snacks.
Quiet! Hands off!
Kids don't drive. Never. Understood?
May I say? Driving before eighteen is not allowed.
Feet don't touch the ground. How will you brake?
Key confiscated!
I have an idea! We'll teach Papa!
I fear nobody... zzz...
Look, colony! Ramesh Sharma... on the road!
Seth ji? My scooty's racing the wind!
Not the wind, you're talking to me. Look ahead!
Namaste, Gupta Aunty! Yes Seth ji, tell me!
One hand on phone, one on namaste... who's holding the scooty?
Ramesh! Look ahead! Ahead!
Ahead? Seth ji, you're on the phone!
I'm fine! Scooty's fine! The boxes...?
My boxes! My showcase!
Empty! This one too!
All empty! Not a single sweet!
Seth ji! Boxes empty?
They're for show! Full boxes are expensive!
See? Only a box fell on the helmet.
Think, what if there was no helmet?
Then my hair would be saved!
Even in all this chaos... Havaldar sahab was fast asleep.
Samosa? I mean... there will be an inquiry!
Strap open, phone in hand... show your licence!
This is a ration card.
This is a gym card. You go to the gym?
Just the card.
This... is some child's report card!
Papa! That's mine!
No licence, phone in hand... challan will be issued!
Havaldar ji... hot, hot samosa? Instead of a challan?
Bribe? And that too aloo? Never!
I'm hungry!
First go to the RTO. Get a learner's licence.
The fine comes out of your pocket money.
My pocket money? I'm the papa!
Papa, from tomorrow... Colony Driving School!
One week later... the kids opened a driving school!
Colony Driving School! Everyone's test today!
May I say? Four rules: helmet, both hands, no phone, licence.
And kids? Only clap!
Learner's licence from the RTO! Now I'm half a driver!
Science says helmets heat up the brain.
Science also says: helmets save heads.
...Yes, that too.
Masterji, first rule: brake!
Break? Yes yes, lunch break!
Indicator!
India Gate? That's in Delhi, beta!
Licence!
Silence? Yes! Everyone quiet!
Come on, let's go!
This one got the evil eye too!
First candidate... an auto?
We're live! The colony's mega test!
No tension! A hero needs no helmet!
No helmet? Out!
One, two, three... wait, again... one...
Seth ji! It's a test, not an audit!
My boxes! Not one less!
Time's up! Next!
Did you hear? I'm giving a test...
Phone!
...I'll tell you later.
Mother! You? On a scooty?
Nineteen eighty licence, beta!
The whole colony will see!
I taught him to ride one too!
First class! Hundred out of hundred!
I fear nobody!
Papa... backwards again!
Now let's see...
While riding... no phone!
After you.
Pass!
But the real licence comes from the RTO, not me.
Ramesh passed! Ramesh passed!
My papa now has a moustache and a licence!
Seth ji! Clap!
Papa's First Ride! One million views!
My hair! 'One million people saw it?!
Now even the comb needs a helmet!
Ramesh... remember one thing.
Helmet is for the head, not the hair.
Fasten the strap, both hands on the handle, phone in pocket.
And kids? Vehicles after eighteen, with a licence.
Till then... clap!
Understood, Dad! Head first, hair later.
Smile, Papa ji!
My lioness...?
Forty-two... count again?
